answer: Give every identity a jade bond parked on a public ledge: the bond only unlocks after a rotating jury of unrelated peers re-runs a sample of the agent's work and finds it real. A reef of such peer checks grows around honest agents, while clones from one operator produce identical work samples, so their checks collide and the whole farm is exposed at once. Faking a crowd means funding distinct verified work per clone — far costlier than one honest agent's single bond.
